lines.text: Did you know? Pos is Latin for put.
Position: a place where something is.
Quick quiz! Which means against plus put?

words.ex: The position of the sofa makes the room look bigger.
You have to pay a deposit when you rent a flat.
The bank is opposite the post office.

publish.title: Pos root: position, deposit and opposite
publish.value: Pos comes from Latin "ponere" (to put, to place). Words: position, deposit and opposite. deposit = de + pos; opposite = op + pos.
